description: High-precision values of P(Q_{k,df} > q), the studentized range upper tail, written by tools/reference/studentized_range_mpmath.py with mpmath; p is a decimal string with 22 significant digits, df 'Inf' is the range of k standard normals; tail is the probability q was chosen for (any q will do). Used by tests/stats/test_srange.py (tolerance studentized_range_tail).

grid.method: ref_srange: nested composite Gauss-Legendre (24 nodes per panel) over t = log s and z, positive geometric-sum form, 24 digits

df_inf.method: ref_range_cancel: tanh-sinh quadrature of the textbook max form with the integrand at 34 + 10 + |log10 tail| digits

fixture_pairs.method: ref_srange as for grid, at the 31 Games-Howell pairs (|q|, Welch df) of the parametric ggbetweenstats fixtures with three or more groups

k2_identity.method: ref_t2: exact P(|T_nu| > q / sqrt 2) = I_x(nu/2, 1/2), x = nu / (nu + q^2 / 2), 60 digits (erfc(q / 2) for nu = Inf)
